CURRENT VACANCIES

Available Positions

LOCATION: HYDERABAD HQ & ZONAL SITES
CIRCUIT DESIGN Hyderabad HQ 4 – 8 Years Exp

Senior Railway Signalling Engineer (EI & Circuit Design)

Lead the preparation and verification of Signalling Interlocking Plans (SIP), Table of Control (TOC), interface circuit schematics, and dog charts for Medha, Kyosan, Siemens, and Hitachi Electronic Interlocking systems across Indian Railways.

CORE TECHNOLOGIES Electronic Interlocking (EI), ATP / Kavach, Relay Logic
QUALIFICATION B.Tech / B.E. (Electrical / Electronics / ECE)
STANDARDS RDSO SEM, IRS-S-76, CENELEC EN 50126
SITE COMMISSIONING Zonal Railway Sites 2 – 5 Years Exp

Site Testing & Commissioning Engineer (Station Interlocking)

Direct on-site installation supervision, interlocking square sheets validation (bell testing), track circuit tuning, digital axle counter integration (HASSDAC/MSDAC), and CRS sanction preparation for junction stations.

CORE RESPONSIBILITY Site Acceptance Testing (SAT), Bell Testing, Point Machines
QUALIFICATION Diploma / B.Tech in Electrical / Electronics
TRAVEL Zonal Railway Division Sites Across India
SYSTEM ASSURANCE Hyderabad / Hybrid 3 – 7 Years Exp

RAMS & Safety Assurance Engineer (CENELEC SIL-4)

Author and review CENELEC EN 50126, EN 50128, and EN 50129 safety cases, Hazard Logs, FMECA sheets, and quantitative Fault Tree Analysis for mission-critical railway electronic signalling equipment.

STANDARDS CENELEC EN 50126, EN 50128, EN 50129 (SIL-4)
EXPERIENCE FMECA, Hazard Logs, V&V Safety Audit Dossiers
QUALIFICATION B.Tech / M.Tech in Systems Engineering / ECE
SOFTWARE ENGINEERING Hyderabad HQ 2 – 5 Years Exp

Railway Software Developer (Automation & CAD Compilers)

Develop and enhance automated interlocking testing platforms (SENTRIS), AutoCAD C# / ObjectARX plugins (Algen & L2L), and interactive train dispatching simulators to eliminate manual drafting errors.

TECH STACK C#, .NET Core, Python, ObjectARX / AutoCAD API
DOMAIN Boolean Logic Equations, Test Vector Engines
QUALIFICATION B.Tech in Computer Science / IT / Software Eng
DRAUGHTSMAN / CAD Hyderabad HQ 1 – 3 Years Exp

Junior Railway Signalling Draughtsman (AutoCAD)

Drafting of locking tables, track circuit bonding schemes, location box wiring diagrams, and power supply cable route layouts under senior engineering guidance following Indian Railways drafting standards.

SOFTWARE AutoCAD, MicroStation, DWG / DXF Standards
FOCUS Wiring Schematics, Location Boxes, Cable Troughs
QUALIFICATION Diploma in Engineering / ITI Draughtsman Civil/Elec
PATH TO MASTERY

Your Career Growth Pathway

How engineers grow from initial circuit drafting to senior railway proof consultant at AAV Works.

STAGE 01

Junior S&T Engineer

Mastering SEM norms, circuit schematics, wiring schedules, and AutoCAD interlocking templates.

STAGE 02

Senior Interlocking Designer

Authoring Table of Control (TOC), complex EI application logic, and turnkey site commissioning.

STAGE 03

Proof Consultant / Lead

Conducting Independent Verification & Validation (IV&V) across Zonal Railway projects.

STAGE 04

Principal Railway Architect

Leading national corridor signalling architectures, CENELEC SIL-4 safety cases, and R&D automation.
